Projects

Audio Equipment Cases

Rapid Prototyping 3D CAD Modelling Client Consultation Tolerance Analysis Material Selection

After mentioning my interests to a local sound technician, he asked if I could design and manufacture devices to store and protect his equipment. I worked with the client to design, prototype and manufacture cases that fit the requirements.

Wing Design and Simulation

Computational Fluid Dynamics 3D CAD Modelling Iterative Design Technical Troubleshooting Aerodynamic Analysis

In my final year of school, I entered a wing design competition run by Cambridge University Drone Society. After modelling my design in CAD, I optimised the lift to drag ratio with CFD by tracing air particles over the wing to identify flaws.

Practical Home Projects

Reverse Engineering Failure Analysis 3D CAD Modelling Multi Part Assembly Design for Additive Manufacturing

I frequently identify quick fixes to simple problems within my household. With my prototyping skills I can quickly sketch up an idea and have a solution ready within hours.
